gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Unique single-stroke brush letters lead the way. Origami's poured-lead lowercase mass hangs heavy beside Noto Kufi Arabic, a sans-serif with a welcoming gap in the c, and that weight gap is the pair's real draw.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans: Brush-stroke swagger, then plain talk. Origami lays down one constant, marker-like line while Noto Sans, with lowercase filling most of the letter height, gives the eye somewhere gentle to land.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Line after line, the tall, full c, s and z keep the text open and easy going, quite unlike Origami's marker-traced heading strokes.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-adlam-un: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous space between curve ends and stems, with hardly any height gap between its cases. Origami's marker-steady line is what you notice first.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-anatolia: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs has terminals that flick outward and an x-height nearly touching cap height. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs moves along briskly in text, lighter than Origami's thick-jointed heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Curves that never thin out at the turns give Origami its sign-painter's look. Noto Sans Arabic, a sans-serif with wide openings and a pronounced x-height, makes that heavy-versus-light gap the pair's best trait.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Noto Sans Armenian stands its lowercase c, s and z tall and full, with wide, inviting openings on round letters. Origami's dowel-like stems and arcs make it the louder voice.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Contemporary at heart, Origami draws pencil-like lines that never thicken or thin. Noto Sans Avestan, with a pronounced x-height and curve tips that stop short of touching, gives those lines a sturdy partner.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Noto Sans Balinese gives every curved glyph a breathing space and keeps its ascenders short against the body height. Origami glows like neon tubing; Noto Sans Balinese simply reads.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Big open counters give Noto Sans Bamum a light, modern feel, its curves stopping before they turn inward. But Origami's ballpoint-plain, pressure-free line is the real hook, and next to it the sans text feels almost weightless.
